program:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (and (= (obj-color obj) 1)
           (>= (obj-h obj) 3)
           (>= (obj-w obj) 3)
           (= (obj-size obj) (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))) 4))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([frame (in-list (filter rect-frame? (objects g 0)))])
      (for*/fold ([acc out])
                 ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1) (obj-r2 frame))]
                  [c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1) (obj-c2 frame))])
        (if (= (at g r c) 4)
            (let ((mc (- (+ (obj-c1 frame) (obj-c2 frame)) c)))
              (if (and (> mc (obj-c1 frame)) (< mc (obj-c2 frame)) (= (at acc r mc) 0))
                  (set-cell acc r mc 7)
                  acc))
            acc)))))
